description: Develop enterprise web applications using Java, Spring Boot, or C# .NET. Implement unit tests, adhere to SOLID design patterns, and maintain code via Git/GitHub. Experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL/MySQL) and RESTful API development is required.

Build high-throughput microservices using Node.js, TypeScript, and Express or FastAPI. Experience with Docker containerization, PostgreSQL relational schemas, and Redis caching. Familiarity with AWS and CI/CD pipelines.

Develop responsive user interfaces using React, Next.js, and TypeScript. Consume RESTful endpoints, manage component state with Zustand or Redux, and style with Tailwind CSS. Basic Git branching knowledge required.

Extract and analyze operational data using SQL and Python (Pandas, NumPy). Construct business dashboards in PowerBI and Tableau. Assist in data cleaning, exploratory data analysis, and metrics reporting.
Write automated test scripts using Python (PyTest) or JavaScript (Playwright/Selenium). Validate backend endpoints using Postman. Participate in defect triage within Agile sprint lifecycles.

Support cloud infrastructure management on AWS and GCP. Deploy containerized services using Docker and Docker Compose. Write shell scripts (Bash/Linux) and configure automated CI/CD using GitHub Actions.
End-to-end full stack development using React on frontend and Node.js/Express or Python on backend. Work with PostgreSQL/MongoDB databases, Git version control, and containerized Docker environments.

Construct automated ETL data pipelines and integrate LLM/ML API endpoints. Proficient in Python, SQL, and Git. Experience with relational and vector databases, data structures, and algorithmic complexity.

Build cross-platform mobile apps using Flutter/Dart or native Kotlin. Integrate client apps with backend RESTful APIs, manage mobile local caching with SQLite, and follow clean architecture guidelines.
Analyze system network logs, verify security telemetry, and evaluate application vulnerabilities. Knowledge of TCP/IP networking, Linux administration, and security scripting with Python.
Develop and maintain business workflows using Python (Django/FastAPI). Write efficient SQL queries for PostgreSQL, implement asynchronous workers with Celery, and practice test-driven development.
Configure and maintain enterprise Linux and Windows servers. Monitor virtual machines, write automation scripts in Bash/PowerShell, and troubleshoot TCP/IP network routing and firewalls.
Create modern web applications using TypeScript, Vue.js or React, and Node.js backend services. Design normalized relational tables and integrate third-party payment and auth APIs.
Support database operations, schema migrations, and indexing strategies on Oracle and PostgreSQL. Ensure database backups, monitor query execution performance, and enforce access security.
Develop NLP and computer vision service integrations. Fine-tune open models, write Python data preprocessing routines, and deploy inference microservices inside Docker containers.
Develop test plans, log bug tickets in Jira, and write UI automation scripts using Cypress. Execute regression testing and API contract testing across web and mobile platforms.
Support client deployments on Microsoft Azure and AWS. Deploy infrastructure configurations using Terraform scripts, maintain container registries, and monitor service uptime.
Implement modern user interfaces using React, JavaScript (ES6+), and CSS/SCSS modules. Collaborate with UI/UX designers and integrate frontend screens with RESTful backend services.
Build backend microservices with Java 17 and Spring Boot framework. Implement ORM mapping with Hibernate, write SQL queries for PostgreSQL, and manage artifacts using Maven/Git.
Create automated analytical dashboards for financial and tech client metrics. Strong SQL querying, Python for data transformation, and mastery of PowerBI or Tableau reporting suites.
